Artefacts

Evidence Repository for Portfolio

Overview

This collection curates the artefacts evidencing my learning, consulting practice, and communication skills during the Biostatistical Consulting & Collaboration module and internship. Every artefact is displayed inline so the portfolio can be reviewed without downloading supporting files.

Module Assignments

Assignment 1 Submission

Comprehensive response for the first block assignment, outlining consultation planning, ethical considerations, and reflective learning points.

Download the PDF if you prefer an external viewer.

Assignment 2 Submission

Second block submission detailing research question framing, stakeholder communication strategies, and recommended analytical pathways.

Download the PDF for offline viewing.

Consultation Artefacts

Explainer Document

Analysis Code

Shiny Application Snapshot

Screenshot of the data exploration Shiny tool highlighting user-facing design elements and core outputs.

Confidentiality and Data Protection

Important

All artefacts have been reviewed to remove identifying information and comply with institutional confidentiality requirements. Shared materials focus on methods, communication pieces, and anonymised outputs suitable for inclusion in this portfolio.
